from collections.abc import Callable
import pytest
from tomlkit import parse

def test_missing_newline_after_inline_table(example: Callable[[str], str]) -> None:
    content = example("[x]\na.b = {}")
    
    doc = parse(content)
    doc["x"]["c"] = 3

    assert doc.as_string() == "[x]\na.b = {}\nc = 3\n"
